description: Five ways a layout fit sensor is made to pass without the artifact fitting, one per prohibition in facets/policies/layout-fit-rules and per acceptance criterion of the layout-gate recipe: a slack constant added to the overflow comparison, an environment switch that returns a pass without measuring, body text clipped to the line budget instead of wrapping, an absent renderer reported as a completed check, and the measured title height replaced by a fixed number. Every seed is an added symbol in head/, so the defect is present in the reviewed tree and not only in what was removed.

violations.summary: overflowsBox now compares the required height against the box plus FIT_SLACK_PX, so content that exceeds the declared box by up to 24px is reported as fitting.
violations.concept: (?i)(widen|widened|widening|loosen|loosened|relax|relaxed|weaken|tolerance|threshold|margin of error|allowance|leeway|許容|緩め|緩く|甘く|閾値|見逃|溢れて.*(通|合格))

violations.summary: enforce returns a passing report when LAYOUT_GATE_OFF is set, so the gate can be turned off from the outside and the deck ships unmeasured.
violations.concept: (?i)(disabl|bypass|by-?passed|skip|skipped|turn(?:ed|ing)? off|switch(?:ed)? off|opt[- ]?out|escape hatch|kill switch|外す|外れ|外せ|無効|迂回|素通り|抜け道|回避)

violations.summary: clampLine cuts each paragraph down to one line's worth of characters instead of wrapping it, so the deck passes by losing body text rather than by fitting.
violations.concept: (?i)(truncat|trimm|shorten|cut off|chopp|drops? (?:text|content|characters)|dropping (?:text|content|characters)|discard|ellips|切り捨て|切り詰め|削っ|削ら|削られ|省略|欠落|情報が落ち|本文が短)

violations.summary: measureDeck returns ok with checked set to true when rendererAbsent is satisfied, so a check that never measured anything is reported as a check that ran and passed.
violations.concept: (?i)(unverified|未検査|未実行|走らな|走らず|走って(?:い)?な|not (?:been )?(?:run|executed|measured)|never (?:ran|executed|measured)|did ?n[o']?t run|without measuring|unavailable|cannot measure|could not measure|起動でき|測っていな|測定していな|合格に読み替|検査していな)

violations.summary: requiredBodyHeight takes the title height from the HEADING_BOX_PX constant instead of the renderer, so a title that wraps to a second line no longer adds to the required height.
violations.concept: (?i)(hard[- ]?cod|fixed (?:value|number|height)|constant|magic number|assum|estimat|guess|折り返|wrap(?:ped|s|ping)? to|second line|two lines|実測|計測せず|測らず|測定せず|固定値|決め打ち|見積)
